verdict.rationale: Orrick's own pages document venture practices across several jurisdictions: global VC rankings, a #1 European VC financing ranking, and UK, German and French venture teams. The France page explicitly cites 'cross border M&A and IPOs', and a Germany-specific incorporation questionnaire shows jurisdiction-tailored venture tooling. However, cross-border venture financings, international-investor representation and flips/redomiciliations are not specifically documented. Missing for 10: any documentation of flips/redomiciliations, explicit cross-border or multi-jurisdiction financing matters, international-investor work, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm documents cross-border venture work — international investors, flips/redomiciliations, or multi-jurisdiction financings
